candidates: A woman opens her window to a vampire and offers him her blood. Sunrise can destroy him, but she has to keep him drinking until then…
A vampire drinks from the woman who willingly invites him inside. She is waiting for dawn. But can she live long enough to see it?
The ship arrives with rats and no living crew. Soon, townspeople are dying, and the vampire moves into a house across from the woman who will invite him inside…
A woman finds a way to destroy the vampire in a book: offer her blood and distract him until dawn. She opens the window, but morning has yet to come…
A woman sends her husband to fetch a physician, leaving her alone for the vampire’s arrival. He enters and drinks her blood. Now she has to hold him there until sunrise…
